question: Which records should lab service:api return, and why does v12 instead return l1?

criteria.instruction: Correct ordered hits are l2 and l4: API-gateway and api_v2 tokenize to an api token after ASCII folding. capital in l1 has no complete api token; l3 only mentions api in notes; g1 is another project. v12 takes g1/l1 as substring hits before project filtering, then leaves l1 and starves later valid hits.
Combine R19 tokenizer/field/project rules, matcher inspection and candidate order. Distinguish interior substring from punctuation-delimited token.
Do not infer the matched diagnoses are true or authorize inclusion of game/notes merely because they contain the text.
